0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 11th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 3.5 games back) are on a one-game losing streak and head into their 11th game of the season on the road against the Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 10th in the West, on a two-game winning streak), with Indiana 0-5 at home and 3-2 away. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Indiana trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and the Pacers lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
